fields.why: The Decant Return Pond supplies both the Pilgan Plant process water ponds and the 5 ML Turkey Nest, but the transfer pumps run in manual only. During high demand the pond has dropped to about 20%, risking insufficient raw water for mining. Automatic level-based pump control would improve transfer reliability while keeping manual mode.
fields.design:
- 322-PU-794 (duty, to Pilgan PW ponds) – Auto start: 322-LT-6110 ≥ 70% and healthy, AND (272-XV-4015 open cmd AND 272-LT-0812 healthy, OR 272-XV-4014 open cmd AND 272-LT-3347 healthy). Auto stop: 322-LT-6110 ≤ 65% or unhealthy, OR both destination paths closed/unhealthy
- 322-PU-796 (duty, to 5 ML Turkey Nest) – Auto start: 322-LT-6110 ≥ 85% and healthy AND 364-PN-101-LT01 ≤ 70% and healthy. Auto stop: 322-LT-6110 ≤ 80% or unhealthy, OR 364-PN-101-LT01 ≥ 90% or unhealthy
- 322-PU-795 common standby – operator selects which duty strategy it follows; automatic valve alignment (322-XV-6126 open when standby to PU-794, closed when standby to PU-796)
- Independent source setpoints prioritise Pilgan process water over the Turkey Nest
- 322-PU-797 NLO decant return pump unchanged; existing manual mode retained
- Refs: PIL-20000-PID-PR-369 Rev 1, PIL-20000-PID-PR-727 Rev 4, PIL-36105-PID-PR-508 Rev 1
fields.impact: Decant transfer pumps can run in Auto on pond levels. Operators choose which duty pump the standby 322-PU-795 backs up. Manual mode remains available.
